evals.name: tradeoff-offer-audit-log
evals.prompt: transcript-audit-log.md is an intake elicitation session you and I are running for an audit-log feature, and it's your turn. I have to jump into a meeting, so write your next message to me into next-turn.md, exactly what you would say to me now, and stop there. Don't write the design or a requirements summary yet.
evals.expected_output: The user's last answer names two viable paths (same-transaction Postgres write vs SQS event + consumer) and says they have no preference. The skill calls for offering, not running, a deliberation panel (or reasoning it through together) alongside answering directly, then resuming elicitation. A generic reply picks a winner, writes a pros/cons recommendation, or ignores the tradeoff and asks the next question.
expectations: next-turn.md exists and contains no requirements-summary headings
next-turn.md states the tradeoff as two named options: writing the audit entry in the same Postgres transaction versus publishing to the SQS queue for a consumer to write, each with what it favors
Offers the user an explicit choice of how to resolve it: decide directly, or convene a deliberation panel / work through it together; the choice is presented as the user's opt-in
Does not decide for the user: no recommendation of one option, no simulated panel debate or verdict in this turn
Stays a single conversational turn: does not batch several new elicitation questions or jump ahead to design content
Wording is neutral and faithful to the transcript (immutability, compliance export, latency, lost-message window) with nothing invented

scripted_checks.text: next-turn.md exists and contains no requirements-summary headings
scripted_checks.check: test -s next-turn.md && ! grep -qiE 'Requirements Confirmed|Functional Requirements|Non-Functional' next-turn.md

evals.name: second-tradeoff-lighter-offer
evals.prompt: transcript-billing-export.md is the intake elicitation session we're in the middle of for a billing export feature. Write your next message to me into next-turn.md, exactly what you'd say to me right now, and stop. I'll answer when I'm back.
evals.expected_output: A second significant tradeoff surfaced (12-month synchronous cap vs async job with emailed link) after the panel was already offered once and declined in favor of answering directly. The skill calls for a lighter prompt (e.g. 'another tradeoff, same treatment?') rather than repeating the full panel pitch, never auto-running the panel and never choosing for the user.
expectations: next-turn.md exists and contains no requirements-summary headings
Names the new tradeoff as two options: a 12-month cap with synchronous generation versus an async job that emails a download link

Uses a lighter follow-up offer appropriate to a second tradeoff in the same session (e.g. asks whether to give it the same treatment or decide directly) instead of repeating the full deliberation-panel pitch with its menu and time estimate
Does not decide for the user and does not run or simulate a panel or give a recommendation
Respects earlier answers: does not re-ask on-demand vs scheduled or the role question, and carries the v1 on-demand decision forward if it mentions it
Stays a single turn: no batch of new questions, no design content

scripted_checks.text: next-turn.md exists and contains no requirements-summary headings
scripted_checks.check: test -s next-turn.md && ! grep -qiE 'Requirements Confirmed|Functional Requirements|Non-Functional' next-turn.md
